name: ND YouTube Mini
description: Play and manage YouTube from ND with background playback in the ND browser and ad blocking on by default. This M1 scaffold contributes a launcher command that opens the queue view, a command that saves a video link, and the list view over saved entries; transport controls, player state, and default-on ad blocking arrive in later milestones.

commands.title: ND YouTube Mini
commands.description: Open the YouTube Mini queue view.

commands.title: Save a YouTube video
commands.description: Save the typed video link as a YouTube Mini queue entry.

views.title: YouTube Mini queue
views.description: No saved videos yet. Type a YouTube link and run Save a YouTube video.
